info.description:
The following endpoints are stateful in the Sandbox: * Retrieve Losses and Claims * Create or Amend Losses and Claims * Delete Losses and Claims # Send fraud prevention data HMRC monitors transactions to help protect your customers' confidential data from criminals and fraudsters.
! Warning You are required by law to submit header data for this API. This includes all associated APIs and endpoints.
[Check the data you need to send](/guides/fraud-prevention/). You can also use the [Test API](/api-documentation/docs/api/service/txm-fph-validator-api/1.0) during initial development and as part of your quality assurance checks. # Mapping APIs to Self Assessment tax return forms Some parameters in this API map to box numbers in one or more Self Assessment tax return forms. To learn more and to download this mapping information as a CSV file, go to [income-tax-mtd-changelog/mapping](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog?tab=readme-ov-file#mapping-apis-to-self-assessment-tax-return-forms) on GitHub. # Changelog You can find the changelog in the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/#readme) on GitHub. # Support * Direct reports of bugs or errors in Production or Sandbox code, or queries about HMRC business functionality (such as how a specific field is used by HMRC or why it is needed) to the [Software Development Support Team (SDST)](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/developer/support). * Send queries or feedback related to the design of the APIs (including recommended changes) using the [income-tax-mtd-changelog](https://github.com/hmrc/income-tax-mtd-changelog/issues) GitHub page. * Is this page not working properly? (opens in new tab)

delete.description:
This endpoint allows a developer to delete a claim or a brought-forward-loss for a specified individual and business for a given tax year.
A National Insurance number, business ID and tax year are required.
  
  ### Test data
  Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.
  
  | Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario                                                                                        |
  |----------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
  | N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates success response.                                                                     |
  | NOT_FOUND                        | Simulates the scenario where no data is found.                                                  |
  | OUTSIDE_AMENDMENT_WINDOW         | Simulates the scenario where request cannot be completed as it is outside the amendment window. |
  | STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful delete.                                                                     |

get.description:
This endpoint allows a developer to retrieve a claim or a brought-forward-loss for a specified individual and business for a given tax year.
A National Insurance number, business ID and tax year are required.

### Test data
Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.

| Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario                                                       |
| -------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates successful response with losses and claims.          |
| TERMINAL_LOSS_CLAIM              | Simulates success response with terminal loss claim.           |
| NOT_FOUND                        | Simulates the scenario where no data is found.                 |
| STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful retrieve.                                  |

carryBack.description: Object containing loss amounts to be carried back.

previousYearGeneralIncome.description: The amount of the current tax year's trading losses to carry back under Section 64 to be off set against general income of the previous year(s). The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

earlyYearLosses.description: The amount of the current tax year's trading losses to carry back under Section 72 to be set off against general income of the previous year(s). The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

terminalLosses.description: The amount of the current tax year's trading losses to be carry back under Section 89 and applied against profits of the three previous years, starting with the latest year first. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

carrySideways.description: Object containing loss amounts to be carried sideways to the current tax year general income.

currentYearGeneralIncome.description: The amount of the current tax year's trading losses to be off set general income of the current tax year under Section 64. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

preferenceOrder.description: Object containing a preference order to be specified.

applyFirst.description:
Specifies the preference order when the current tax year's trading losses have been claimed under Section 64 to set against general income of a previous year and set against general income of the current tax year.

Limited to the following possible values:
* carry-sideways 
* carry-back

carryForward.description: Object containing loss amounts to be carried forward.

currentYearLosses.description: The amount of trading losses in the current tax year carried forward to offset future profits of the same trade under Section 83. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

previousYearsLosses.description: The amount of trading losses from previous years carried forward to offset future profits of the same trade under Section 83. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

losses.description: Object containing brought forward loss amount.

broughtForwardLosses.description: The amount of brought forward losses to be applied in the current tax year against any the current tax year profits. The value must be between 0 and 99999999999.99 up to 2 decimal places.

put.description:
This endpoint allows a developer to submit or amend a claim or a brought-forward-loss for a specified individual and business for a given tax year.  A National Insurance number, business ID and tax year are required.
**This endpoint can only be used after the tax year has ended.**

**Note:** It is essential that customers submit carry back losses before the final declaration when tax liability adjustments are submitted using the Create or Amend Tax Liability Adjustments endpoint in the [Individuals Tax Liability Adjustments API](https://developer.service.hmrc.gov.uk/api-documentation/docs/api/service/individuals-tax-liability-adjustments-api).

### Test data
Scenario simulation using Gov-Test-Scenario headers is only available in the sandbox environment.

| Header Value (Gov-Test-Scenario) | Scenario                                                                                         |
|----------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| N/A - DEFAULT                    | Simulates successful response.                                                                   |
| NOT_FOUND                        | Simulates the scenario where no data is found.                                                   |
| CARRY_BACK_CLAIM                 | Simulates the scenario where carry back claim type is supplied for a property income source.     |
| OUTSIDE_AMENDMENT_WINDOW         | Simulates the scenario where request cannot be completed as it is outside the amendment window.  |
| STATEFUL                         | Performs a stateful create or update.                                                            |

allow in-year submissions for endpoints configured for end-of-year submissions. Not supplying the header or setting 
it to `false` results in a `RULE_TAX_YEAR_NOT_ENDED` error for in-year submissions. In Production, the header is
ignored and normal validations apply.
